Acceptance_Rule: Observed source timestamps and identifiers remain unchanged.
Every modeled call has a non-missing IMO_Normalised.
Every modeled call has a non-missing UNLOCODE_Normalised.
Timestamp-derived interval is reconciled with Actual_Stay_Hours; discrepancies remain visible.
Every included call creates one arrival and one departure event.
All included calls have departed by the end of replay.
Area under port concurrency equals the sum of included observed call intervals.
Repeated baseline replay yields identical metrics.
Consecutive port calls are not described as verified physical sailing routes.
Port-call concurrency is not labelled actual berth occupancy/capacity.
No actual Hormuz transit is asserted without independent AIS/transit evidence.
Future experiments report per-vessel accumulated and final delay separately.
Unrecovered and right-censored calls/vessels are separately identified.
